mechanism.initial_resources: one pre-existing certificate and one reusable gift card
mechanism.certificate_transition: the certificate is removed after its first successful booking and unused value is forfeited
mechanism.planning_dependency: prices and both bookings must be considered before the first commit
mechanism.correct_allocation: gift card funds the lower-cost first booking; certificate is reserved for the later booking that the remaining gift-card balance cannot cover
mechanism.competing_allocation: certificate funds the lower-cost first booking; the later booking cannot be completed from the remaining authorized resource
